# Workday Blog

> Workday's official blog covering enterprise software, AI innovation, and industry-specific insights for modern businesses.

The Workday Blog provides thought leadership, product updates, and industry trends across healthcare, enterprise resource planning, and artificial intelligence. Content is authored by Workday experts and covers practical applications of AI agents, agentic AI, and digital transformation strategies.
